The prices apply to user group 0 (households and other customers on the low-voltage network). Customers without 15-minute metering are billed differently and are not shown here.
The amounts exclude taxes, levies, excise duties and other charges.
The power rate is charged on the agreed (and any excess) billing power in each time block, regardless of the kWh used. The energy rate is charged on the energy taken in kWh.
Block 1 applies only on working days in the higher season (November–February).
The price list is for information only. The valid rates are published by the operator (SODO).
An unofficial app, not affiliated with the Energy Agency, SODO or the operators. The data comes from public sources (Data sources); calculations are for information.

Tarifni semafor – moja poraba can tell you when a new time block begins and show the current block as an icon in the status bar. Android needs your permission for this.\n\nYou can change or turn off notifications at any time in Settings. The app never sends ads or other messages.
